explanation: The order uses the full budget. Rather than scale every line proportionally, it brings stock plus receipts to at least forecast B’s 14-day total for every SKU. Teatime Fairy cases need no order on that basis. The remaining funds go mainly to Retro Spot cake cases and heart holders, where forecast A is higher than B. The trade-off is less than one unit of cushion above B for each jumbo bag. Neither forecast guarantees demand will match it, and receipts on day seven cannot recover earlier missed sales.
